Default.ifYouSubmitThe:
If you submit the uniquely most popular answer, you win 10 points!
If you submit the uniquely least popular answer, you lose 5 points!

Otherwise, your score doesn't change.

Default.ifYouHaveTo:
If you have to type in your answer, capitalization doesn't matter, but spelling does 😔

Agree on some conventions as a group, such as 'singular nouns only' - this is part of the game!
